name: Moonshrine Sanctum
summary: Moonshrine Sanctum is an ancient elven shrine deep within Blackfathom Deeps, now serving as the inner redoubt for the Twilight's Hammer cult. Presided over by Twilight Lord Kelris, the chamber houses a pristine monument to Queen Azshara and directly guards the sealed entrance to Aku'mai's lair.

sections.title: A Desecrated Temple
sections.body: Situated just beyond the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, the Moonshrine Sanctum represents the central hub of cultist activity inside Blackfathom Deeps. Though originally built millennia ago by night elves to honor the moon and their rulers, the hall is now defiled by the Twilight's Hammer. Interestingly, the cultists have carefully maintained the towering effigy of Queen Azshara, finding kinship with the serpentine naga who serve the same dark, submerged masters. Under the watchful gaze of Twilight Lord Kelris, dark rituals are chanted day and night beneath the cavernous stone ceiling.

sections.title: The Threshold to Aku'mai
sections.body: The sanctum acts as the final barricade before Aku'mai's Lair. Heavy double stone doors seal away the monstrous hydra, held fast by ancient warding enchantments. Surrounding Azshara's central statue are four ritual braziers that must be ignited to unravel the seal. Doing so disturbs the slumbering guardians of the shrine—hordes of giant crabs, snapped-jaw turtles, armored makrura, and conjured water elementals bound to defend the sanctum against unwary intruders.

faq.answer: The Moonshrine Sanctum is located deep inside the Blackfathom Deeps dungeon along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. It lies just past the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, immediately preceding the lair of the hydra Aku'mai.

faq.q: Who rules over the Moonshrine Sanctum?
faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris commands the sanctum. He is a formidable sleep-weaving sorcerer of the Twilight's Hammer cult who conducts rituals to honor their ancient void-touched patron.

faq.q: Why is there an intact statue of Azshara here?
faq.answer: The sanctum was originally an ancient elven temple dedicated to Queen Azshara prior to the Great Sundering. The Twilight's Hammer maintains the effigy in pristine shape because the cult works in direct league with Azshara's naga beneath the deeps.

faq.q: How do you open the large doors at the back of the chamber?
faq.answer: To unlock the doors leading into Aku'mai's Lair, adventurers must ignite four ritual candles set around the feet of the Azshara statue. Lighting each candle awakens waves of guardian aquatic beasts and water elementals that must be subdued.

angles.text: Seeing an ancient temple carved by your ancestors in the age before the Sundering perverted into a sacrificial hollow for the Twilight's Hammer and naga is a sickening testament to Ashenvale's encroaching shadows.
The twisted rituals performed by Twilight Lord Kelris in this chamber invert sacred devotions, channeling maddening whispers of the void rather than restorative divine prayer.
